title: December, 2014
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
source: lore/drift_wood/_SOURCE_BRIEF.md (Low Tide at Alsea Bay · deepening)
logline: Wednesday. Does Chloe come home. A card, printed, from the island — the first with two names on it. Inside, handwritten: 'I heard. —C.' Wood pins it beside the schedule. The pup pulls it down twice. Wood pins it higher.

panels.composition: The garage. WOOD opening a card: a printed photo of the pavilion in snow, two names. BARNABY II at his boot, already interested in the envelope.
props: a card: the pavilion, two names

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man opening a printed holiday card showing a glass pavilion in snow while a small three-legged puppy noses the envelope at his boot
image.notes: Two names on the card; the second is a neutral shape of letters. Reserved: Julian's surname.

panels.composition: Inside. Her hand: 'I heard. —C.' Three words.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, close-up of the inside of a card with three handwritten words and an initial

panels.composition: The card pinned beside the 1999 schedule. The pup jumping — three legs, all of them — and pulling it down. Twice, in one panel, drawn as two pups.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a small three-legged puppy jumping at a corkboard and pulling down a card, drawn twice in the same panel to show two attempts

panels.composition: The card pinned higher. Out of reach. The pup sitting under it, looking up. Wood sitting beside him, looking up too. She does not come home; the card did.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man and a small puppy sitting side by side on a garage floor both looking up at a card pinned high on a corkboard, no words

notes: 'I heard. —C.' Pulled down twice. Pinned higher.
